dependencies.name: PyYAML
dependencies.notes: OKF v0.2 frontmatter parser; stdlib fallback ships when absent.

dependencies.name: anyio
dependencies.notes: Async runtime required by the MCP server. Declared in tools/mcp/project-context-mcp/pyproject.toml.

dependencies.name: trio
dependencies.notes: Optional anyio backend used by the MCP server. Declared in tools/mcp/project-context-mcp/pyproject.toml.

dependencies.name: httpx
dependencies.notes: Required by the MCP server's HTTP client surface (FastMCP).

dependencies.name: starlette
dependencies.notes: ASGI framework used by the MCP HTTP/SSE transport.

dependencies.name: uvicorn
dependencies.notes: ASGI server used by the MCP HTTP/SSE transport.

dependencies.name: pydantic
dependencies.notes: Required by the MCP server's tool/schema surface.

dependencies.name: sentence-transformers
dependencies.notes: Phase 4 retrieval opt-in dependency. Powers the multilingual-st embedding adapter and the cross-encoder reranker adapter. Apache-2.0 covers the runtime; the model weights are evaluated separately (Apache-2.0 paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2, MIT cross-encoder/ms-marco-MiniLM-L-6-v2).

dependencies.name: cross-encoder-ms-marco-MiniLM-L-6-v2
dependencies.notes: Phase 4 default cross-encoder reranker model weights. Apache-2.0 model card at huggingface.co; the weight license is MIT (see §5.4 model-license inventory).

dependencies.name: paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2
dependencies.notes: Phase 4 default multilingual sentence-transformer model weights; covers DE/EN/UK and opt-in RU per the §25 spec.
